name: Twitch
title: the Plague Rat

Q.name: Ambush
Q.description: Twitch Camouflages and gains 10% Move Speed for 10/11/12/13/14 seconds. The Move Speed increases to 30% while near an enemy champion that can't see him. After exiting Camouflage, Twitch gains 40/45/50/55.0/60% Attack Speed for 6 seconds. When an enemy champion dies while afflicted with Venom, this Ability's Cooldown is refreshed.
Q.summary: Twitch becomes Camouflaged for a short duration and gains Move Speed. When leaving Camouflage, Twitch gains Attack Speed for a short duration. When an enemy champion with Deadly Venom dies, Ambush's cooldown is reset.

W.name: Venom Cask
W.description: Twitch hurls a cask that adds a stack of Deadly Venom to all enemies struck and leaves behind a toxic cloud that persists for 3 seconds. Enemies that remain within the cloud are Slowed by 30/35/40/45/50 + 0.06×AP% and receive an additional stack of Deadly Venom each second.
W.summary: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes in an area, slowing targets and applying deadly venom to the target.

E.name: Contaminate
E.description: Deals 20/30/40/50/60 physical damage to all nearby enemies affected by Deadly Venom, plus an additional 15/20/25/30/35 + 0.35×bonus AD physical damage and 0.35×AP magical damage per stack of Deadly Venom. Max Damage: 20/30/40/50/60 + (6 × 15/20/25/30/35) + (0.35 × 6)×bonus AD physical damage and (0.35×AP) × 6 magical damage.
E.summary: Twitch wreaks further havoc on poisoned enemies with a blast of his vile diseases.

R.name: Spray and Pray
R.description: Twitch unleashes his crossbow, gaining 300 Attack Range and 30/45/60 Attack Damage, and causing his Attacks to become piercing bolts for 6 seconds. These bolts hit all enemies they pass through, but deal 10% less damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of 60% damage.
R.summary: Twitch unleashes the full power of his crossbow, shooting bolts over a great distance that pierce all enemies caught in their path.

Passive.name: Deadly Venom
Passive.description: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing true damage each second.
Passive.summary: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing true damage each second.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Hyper-scaling marksman who stacks Deadly Venom on attacks and uses Camouflage (Q) to flank. Wins teamfights from stealth with R's long-range piercing attacks and Contaminate (E).
strengths: R: very long-range piercing attacks in teamfights
weaknesses: Weak early laning, short range without R
No dash: dies to engage once revealed
Relies on Camouflage timing; easy to punish on cooldown

curve.lvl3: medium – E burst on stacked targets
curve.items: strong – Blade of the Ruined King or Kraken Slayer, big at Guinsoo's/2-3 items

profile.curveNote: Needs stacks + E to trade; plays safe early and scales.
profile.mobility: low – Q move speed + Camouflage only

Passive.notes: Attacks apply stacking true damage over time.

Q.notes: Camouflage + move speed; attack speed on exit; resets on venom kills.

E.notes: Deals damage per venom stack to all poisoned enemies in range.

R.notes: Long range; attacks pierce all enemies in a line.

profile.windowAgainst: Q down (no stealth flank) or early levels before items: walk at him.
checks: W cask treated as not a projectile; confirm whether Yasuo W blocks it.
